name: tender-gate-os
description: TGOS — UK public-sector tender document checking (Procurement Act 2023)

scripts.verify: node tools/validate.mjs && node tools/rules.test.mjs && node tools/tokens.test.mjs
scripts.setup:check: node -e "const v=process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); if(v[0]<22){console.error('Node 22+ required, found '+process.versions.node); process.exit(1)} console.log('Node '+process.versions.node+' OK')"
